title: Checked scalar expression and statement execution
summary: Connects typed scalar descriptors and their evaluated state transitions to exact instruction execution, including assignments, sequences, conditionals, and preserved locals.
premises: An exact equality between the emitted region and the descriptor program
A checked descriptor evaluation to the proposed resulting state
A continuation from the resulting state
Empty initial and final operand stacks when using the Locals frame adapter
result: The exact scalar region preserves the store and reaches its continuation with the evaluated state. The write set and scratch boundary determine preserved getters.
